notes: mēʿimmāk is one fused preposition holding *of*, the suffix keeping *thee*; splitting would leave one of the two prepositions unrepresented beside the other holding the whole word, which rule 30 forbids. Source head is the governing opening morpheme (rule 23's `מֵאֵת` → *of*).
kî ʾim → *but* is rule 35's named fusion, headed on kî.
The vocative Israel takes no *O* because the ASV writes none (rule 36).
